tagline: North America's largest value-added distributor of essential water and air solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Ferguson operated 1,746 branches in the United States and Canada in fiscal 2025 against 1,679 in fiscal 2021. That physical network is the structural base behind organic growth and bolt-on acquisitions, and a better read on the size of a distributor than net sales alone.

ai_positioning.summary: Ferguson sells no artificial intelligence products and discloses no AI-related revenue. The subject appears only as a risk: competitors adopting emerging technologies faster, and data leakage from the use of AI. The company highlights its digital sales channels and system-to-system ordering, run by a chief digital and information officer, without any technology narrative.
evidence: The transition report filed on 27 February 2026 names generative and agentic artificial intelligence among the emerging technologies competitors could adopt faster; the previous report mentioned generative AI only.
The same document lists the use of AI among the possible causes of a failure to protect sensitive data, alongside data corruption and cybersecurity incidents.
The risk list adds the inability to adapt strategy quickly to emerging technologies, a wording absent from the fiscal 2025 annual report.
The value-added solutions described by the company rest on digital commerce, system-to-system exchanges, virtual design and prefabrication; none is presented as an artificial intelligence product.
